integrity: All computations are from a standalone local checker; mathematical priority and correctness have not received independent assessment.
scientific_limitations: An explicit two-state recurrence and sharp obstruction for finite reflexive rooted tree frames. No claim to a closed elementary form of the entropy constant or uniqueness in all literature. Reproducible finite tests corroborate but do not replace the all-size proof.
title: Exact bounded-morphism census and sharp branching threshold for rooted trees
